The gate parameter is $\beta=5$. The surrogate is trained with batches of 32 of its 256 parameter points in the Adam phase and on all of them in the L-BFGS phase. Runs with a fourfold or threefold budget multiply both iteration numbers. A dash: not recorded in the result tables.}
